Let your imagination loose with the wide variety of items at your disposal: melee weapons, guns and even barrels!

Welcome to PEZ Play, the PEZ games app.

You have 23 great activities and games to choose from – from challenging puzzles to fast-paced mini-games. The entire app is free of charge!  
 
Find games you like by filtering according to level of difficulty. Or scroll down to the bottom and take a look at all the activities to choose from. You can now also save the games you enjoy most as favourites to find them even faster – just tap on the heart under the game.  
 
The games are varied and suitable for children. There’s something here for everyone: proving your skills, training your memory, letting your creativity soar, quenching your thirst for action, or simply having fun! 
 
Bot Escape: Help the PEZ robot collect lightning bolts so that its battery doesn’t run out.  

Fashion Island: Have your PEZ character try on different clothes and take a picture of the two of you together.  

Stardust Stage: The game is for all you avid singers out there – create your own melody! 

Brain Training: Get the little PEZ figure to pick pieces of fruit with specific numbers. 

Candy Island: Feed the PEZ figure with candies matching in colour – but time is of the essence! 

Hyper Racer: Fly with a spaceship through different game worlds, avoid obstacles and collect PEZ candies.  

Memory Match: The PEZ figures up north also like to play memory. Join in! 

Adventure Island: Summon up those memory cells and repeat the sequence shown to you on screen. 

Jungle Island: Get your little PEZ figure to jump at the right time for it to hang itself onto the swinging chain. 

Builder’s Island: Stack the PEZ candies on top of each other and build the highest tower. 

Gyro Boxers: Knock away falling meteorites with your boxing gloves and collect points.  

Space Showers: Catch falling meteorites with your special spacecraft.  

Tribal Tribulations: Throw large stones through the rings: the smaller the ring, the more points you get.  

Surf School: Help the PEZ figure cross the sea, avoid obstacles and collect points.  

Deep Sea Divers: Go treasure hunting in the water – the deeper you go, the more precious the treasures.  

Parachuters: Parachute jumping is loads of fun, but it can be dangerous. Help your PEZ figure to land safely.  

Pogo Planet: Let your PEZ figure compete with the inhabitants of a foreign planet and see who jumps to the treasure first.  

Panic Puzzlers: At the beginning you see a colourful picture. It disappears and reappears cut into pieces. Can you manage to piece up the puzzle again?  

Ball Rollers: Your PEZ figure balances on a disc with a ball. Help it to dodge falling meteorites and to collect PEZ candies.  

Funfair Island: Change your face with the PEZ flavours and take a fun picture.  

Painters: Help out the creative artist and draw what he tells you to on the screen. 

Play Island: Help the PEZ figure to jump over the rope and collect points.  

  You’ll find more information at www.pez-play.com.  

Fun with PEZ can be a part of real life! Use your device’s camera to place the PEZ figures next to you, take a selfie and share it with your friends!
